checkpoints.name: FIDELITY

checkpoints.outcome: kidney failure, sustained >=40% eGFR decrease, or renal death

evidence.quote: The composite kidney outcome of kidney failure, sustained ≥40% eGFR decrease, or renal death occurred in 854 (13.1%) and 995 (15.3%) patients receiving finerenone and placebo, respectively (HR, 0.85; 95% CI, 0.77–0.93; P = 0.0004
